notes.title: The Match! Update
notes.content:
Hello Lighthouse Keepers,

It’s been a while since our last update, but we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes! Today, we’re excited to share a new patch. While it doesn’t overhaul any major systems, we believe these changes will make your experience even more enjoyable. Here’s what’s new:

 Subtitles are now available for all the existing audio languages!
 Updated controller visuals in the tutorials.
 Various minor bug fixes for a smoother experience.

And now, something many of you have requested...

 We’ve reworked the Chap4 puzzle! Based on your feedback, we aimed to strike a balance—keeping the unique gameplay twist while making it feel fairer and satisfying to solve. Moving around the match in the lighthouse’s confined space still offers a bit of challenge, but we’re confident the puzzle is now more intuitive and a more rewarding part of your journey.

We hope you enjoy these updates and make sure to keep your lights shining bright!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/52b53fdf9b9d2d36579cbf7fbac47e66bec49d9d.png

notes.title: Early Access live for One True Path
notes.content:
InnerspaceVR is proud to reveal One True Path, a unique narrative-driven VR adventure. From the developers of the critically-acclaimed A Fisherman’s Tale, embark on a thrilling adventure mixing action, puzzle and mystery. Travel between fictional worlds with wildly different visual styles, genres and gameplay. Solve the mysterious murder of best-selling but embittered gamebook author Jack Stevenson by diving headfirst into the grim and fantastical worlds of his Fiendish Fates© series.

[previewyoutube=AZqlYZ_EdAU;full][/previewyoutube]

EXPERIENCE A WIDE VARIETY OF ACTION & PUZZLE GAMEPLAY
Travel through 3 fantastical worlds from Jack’s Fiendish Fates book series, each featuring different themes and gameplay: Magical sword in hand, slash your way through the necromantic Army of Evil, led by the demonic Grey Knight. In Butchers of Orion, use your mind-powers and body-hopping abilities to escape the slaughterhouse spaceship of the life-sucking Lady Oriana and her drones. Blast the corrupt guards of Sheriff Cassidy’s wasteland penitentiary with your shock-hand and trusty cyber-shooter in Prisoner of the Cyberhounds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/631343c77610f2d8fc45a8bd15ec0e1e91b3b95b.png

UNVEIL THE MYSTERY OF THE AUTHOR’S DEATH
Witness Jack Stevenson’s personal rise and fall, as you explore his final and most intimate work.
Discover clues, secrets and personal notes to decipher the story behind the books and the true meaning of your journey through Jack’s fictional worlds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/d4e2fb90b545f0e81859cc0684d1c20c159bd0fd.png

PREPARE FOR A MIND-BENDING JOURNEY
Jack’s final masterpiece couldn’t really be complete without one of his world-famous twists. But he never expected this twist: the death of the author! Discover Jack’s true killer by exploring the grim and fantastical worlds of his Fiendish Fates gamebook series! Escape his stories’ perils through cracks in between the worlds! Exploit interdimensional portals to cross between place, time, and gameplay styles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/46ab502b1f2be7cef5dd747a6d4894bbe109e3b5.png

Are you ready, adventurer? Your journey starts here!

The iconic mystery game that chilled you to the bone in the 90s, the 7th Guest, has been brought back to life with cutting-edge VR technology that delivers an atmospheric and haunting story.

Six guests have been welcomed to the foreboding mansion. But something sinister is at play…

notes.title: Another Fisherman's Tale is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The sequel to the VR Game of the Year 2019, Another Fisherman's Tale tells another magical, moving story about the meaning we can give to our lives, through building and rebuilding our own selves.

[previewyoutube=MIh37NPmJXw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096570/Another_Fishermans_Tale/

Several hours next-gen VR poetic storytelling
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/a78a798277e0bc749569144288bb58028f7ef6a6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/63c4b19fbd75821c8684a1f0f525f61136f91b3c.png

The stories of two characters divided by time collide, as you search for the truth about Bob's past. Through Nina's eyes, you'll re-enact his adventures and unravel the mysteries of his past and expeditions, the pirates, sunken ships, treasures, and mystical locations.

A set of all-new mind-bending core VR mechanics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/bfd28f552bafc9479f1fee5a3b1fb7701bc83462.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/00a21512459fd4dae384b78590fd7d860a620785.png

A unique setting for a whimsical VR
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/8527d66036049d9bc5aabade1563c4416fabe0e4.png

While Nina is cleaning up the basement of her mother's house, she discovers another old model from her father, Bob the Fisherman. And so, the adventure continues...

notes.title: Embark on a new adventure in "Another Fisherman's Tale"!
notes.content:
We're proud to announce the sequel to A Fisherman's Tale, continuing the story of Bob the Fisherman in "Another Fisherman's Tale"!

[previewyoutube=vmVnFmYZO2g;full][/previewyoutube]

In this new upcoming adventure, we step into the shoes of Nina, the daughter of the original game’s protagonist, as she discovers models, notes and photographs that document her father’s mysterious past, as well as her own childhood.

Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2096570/Another_Fishermans_Tale/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/eeb98a78dbf3bff9297bf157e42e320376742381.png

Featuring a total reinvention of its predecessor’s mechanics, Another Fisherman’s Tale imagines a world where YOU are the puzzle:

DETACH limbs and hands from your body and physically control them remotely. Throw Bob’s hand across a ravine and then make it crawl to retrieve an object, or send your head elsewhere for a different view of things.

REPLACE any of your limbs with a variety of objects to unlock new skills. Pirate hook hands allow you to climb up walls, a crab’s claw can cut through a rope in a pinch, and a fish’s tail will improve your swimming ability.

CONTROL your environment with your puppeteering hands, picking up distant objects, items and tools and interacting with each level’s unique layout.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33374325/fddf9054e88c19c8283509636426ad29de1181dc.png

🎣 Visit the website
🎣 Read the full announcement


We can't wait for you to come back to this world in a new mind-bending story!

notes.title: Traffic Jams brings traffic chaos to Oculus Quest, PlayStation VR and Major PC VR Platforms in September!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/a4b36c921eaa97ea91b0f2fe86cea83fbf533e31.jpg

Get your first hands-on with the first level of Traffic Jams in the demo on Steam!

In the world of Traffic Jams all traffic lights have gone out and you are the only one who can keep traffic flowing in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. You start off in the quiet town of Gouda, but as you progress, traffic control job offers soon start pouring in from iconic cities around the globe. 

Rude pedestrians, impatient drivers, and the occasional meteorite will be yours to control before road rage strikes. Yes, you read that right; meteorites! But those aren’t the only hazards; This chaotic VR game is full of monsters, (un)natural disasters, and something called… ‘cheese bowling’?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301930/Traffic_Jams/

During the UploadVR Summer Showcase, we've announced couch party mode! Share the fun of VR with up to four friends (read: frenemies), locally, on mobile devices! Have a look at the multiplayer trailer featuring none other than VR content creators Cas & Chary!


Meet Dennis, your instructor.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/935f8e316a856f68af08343962adf863670f55b1.jpg

Dennis is your greatest frenemy, your rival, but most importantly, for better or for worse, your teacher. Hailing from Jam City, the self-proclaimed "best traffic controller...EVER", takes you under his wing. His experience comes from the many flash mobs and packed intersections that his hometown is known for. Armed with dreams of superstardom, a sassy attitude and fresh dance moves, he has taken it upon himself to teach YOU the ropes of traffic controlling.

If you give him a chance, (and the occasional dance), he'll take you on a jam-packed global adventure to become the Ultimate Traffic Showman.

This is only the first glimpse of the cities you’ll be handling in Traffic Jams, as there will be many different challenges, each with their own crazy events to face on this worldwide trip! We hope to see you on the crossroads for the full release; Traffic Jams will be available for Oculus Quest, PlayStation VR and all major PC VR platforms in September 2020.

For more news about Traffic Jams, find us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram to stay up to date on all things Traffic Jams, and sign up for the newsletter at trafficjams-vr.com

notes.title: Revealed: Post-apocalyptic VR Action FPS "After the Fall"
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/b2e888000ffc2edb61bfc1ccc16311ad2270ef7e.jpg

Survive a vast, hostile world with seamless cooperative multiplayer made for VR

We’re excited to finally reveal our biggest VR game yet: After the Fall, an epic, post-apocalyptic multiplayer VR action FPS. Survive a vast, hostile world with seamless co-op gameplay at its core.

Set in the post-apocalyptic, ice-covered ruins of an alternate 1980s Los Angeles, in After the Fall you play in a team of up to four players, against a vast, hostile world in a raging fight for control of the city and the survival of humanity. Go solo or join forces with players worldwide as you scavenge the remains of civilization, face relentless hordes and larger-than-life bosses, craft a huge range of guns and deadly close combat weapons, and wield devastating powers with real-life movements.

Watch the E3 trailer here.

After the Fall combines an unprecedented VR world shared with players worldwide, a cinematic and atmospheric campaign, action-packed solo and multiplayer gameplay, and endgame built from the ground up for VR. You can register for beta access for a chance to play at http://afterthefall-vr.com.

A word from our Studio Director, Richard Stitselaar
“Arizona Sunshine was one of the first full-feature games developed exclusively for VR. Ever since, we’ve been eager to take it up a few notches and push hard at the boundaries of VR again. With After the Fall, we’re bringing VR to life at a scale we believe hasn’t been done before – a seamless multiplayer experience set in a dynamic, changing world that will keep players coming back for more.”

After the Fall is coming to VR in 2020.  

For more news about After the Fall and to register for a chance at beta access, please visit http://afterthefall-vr.com, find us on Facebook and Twitter, and wishlist the game on Steam

notes.title: A Fisherman’s Tale Out Now: Step into a world where physics are broken, and your every move is infinity replicated...
notes.content:
A Fisherman’s Tale Out Now: Step into a world where physics are broken, and your every move is infinity replicated...

A Fisherman’s Tale Out Now: Step into a world where physics are broken, and your every move is infinity replicated...

Innerspace VR and Vertigo Games are proud to announce that A Fisherman’s Tale, the mind-bending & multi-dimensional VR adventure is available from today for HTC Vive headsets for $14.99/EUR 14.99! 

A Fisherman’s Tale traps you inside a replica where you will need to work with infinite, ever smaller and bigger replications of yourself to find your way out of a world where physics are utterly broken.
 
Seeing is believing, so we’ve created a live-action launch trailer for you guys to check out! ==>

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uj0cxBlKK8c

 In a nutshell, A Fisherman’s Tale will have you:
 Break more than a couple laws of physics in mind-bending VR puzzles!
 Team up with yourself in revolutionary multi-dimensional single player co-op!
 Meet some of the quirkiest sidekicks to have ever set foot in a VR game
 Use your hands to pick up, throw, combine, and use all kinds of things in glorious fully immersive virtual reality!
 Toy around with your tiny little model lighthouse, inside a lighthouse, inside a... is that another lighthouse?
 Uncover the truth at the core of an unusually tall tale, exclusively in VR


On top of that, A Fisherman’s Tale is a journey of both introspection and extrospection, asking players to both reach inside and outside of themselves for answers. What does it mean to reach the top of the lighthouse, and turn on the light?
 
Without VR, there wouldn’t have been an A Fisherman’s Tale. Our goal was to bring the adventure game genre to VR in a way that is meaningful to the genre. We hope you’ll think we succeeded!
 
We’re extremely excited for you to discover the game, and can’t wait to read your comments online!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33374325/21c1271686c84604fae5abd8fbef6f56b3730d71.png
